Reduce all demo, mock, placeholder, and generated data across the entire on system and standardize the system to use only 5 realistic beneficiary profiles connected throughout all modules. 



GLOBAL DATA RULES



* Use only 5 realistic beneficiary/client profiles in the entire system.

* All services, transactions, reports, activities, notifications, analytics, and statistics must reference these same 5 client profiles.

* Remove all excessive dummy records, fake data, lorem ipsum text, placeholder content, and autogenerated samples.

* Do not create additional beneficiaries beyond the 5 master client profiles.

* Maintain full database relationships between Client Records and all service modules.

* One beneficiary may have multiple service availments when appropriate.

* All records must appear realistic, professional, and suitable for actual MSWD operations.

* Generate realistic data based on actual MSWD use cases and beneficiary scenarios.



APPLY TO ALL MODULES



* Client Profiling & Records

* CICL Assistance

* Day Care Services

* Supplementary Feeding Program

* Women and Solo Parent Assistance

* PWD Services

* Elderly Services

* AICS

* Disaster Relief Assistance

* Burial Assistance

* Job Fair Management

* TUPAD

* DOLE Livelihood Program

* Sustainable Livelihood Program (SLP)

* OFW Registration

* OWWA Assistance

* Beneficiary Portal

* Reports Dashboard

* Notifications

* Audit Logs

* Analytics



DASHBOARD REQUIREMENTS



Update all dashboards to reflect only the 5 realistic beneficiaries and their connected service transactions.



MAIN DASHBOARD



* Total Beneficiaries = 5

* Program statistics must be calculated from actual linked records.

* Recent Activities should display only activities generated by the 5 beneficiaries.

* Recent Applications should display only applications connected to the 5 beneficiaries.

* Charts and graphs must use real sample data instead of random values.

* Remove inflated numbers such as hundreds or thousands of beneficiaries unless generated by actual records.

* Remove Pending Approvals cards, approval widgets, approval charts, approval notifications, and approval-related statistics.

* Replace approval metrics with operational metrics such as:



  * Active Beneficiaries

  * Ongoing Services

  * Completed Services

  * New Applications

  * Program Distribution

  * Service Utilization



MODULE DASHBOARDS



* Display only records associated with the 5 beneficiaries.

* Update counters, widgets, charts, tables, badges, and summary cards accordingly.

* Ensure statistics match actual records stored in the system.

* Remove approval-related tables, filters, badges, counters, and widgets.



BENEFICIARY DASHBOARD



* Display only information related to the logged-in beneficiary.

* Show realistic application history, documents, notifications, and service availments.

* Remove approval tracking sections.

* Use service statuses only.



REPORTS DASHBOARD



* Generate reports using only the 5 connected beneficiaries and their service records.

* Charts, graphs, and exports must match actual stored data.

* Remove fake reporting metrics and placeholder statistics.

* Remove approval reports and approval analytics.



ANALYTICS DASHBOARD



* All charts must derive data from actual sample records.

* No random percentages, fabricated trends, or placeholder values.

* Statistics must update dynamically based on existing records.

* Focus analytics on beneficiaries, programs, services, and utilization rates.



SYSTEM WORKFLOW



The PMS no longer uses a Supervisor role or approval workflow.



Workflow:



1. Client Profile Created

2. Service Application Created

3. Service Record Processed

4. Service Status Updated

5. Service Completed



Use only operational statuses such as:



* Pending

* In Progress

* Completed

* Cancelled

* Closed



NOTIFICATIONS



Remove approval-related notifications such as:



* Awaiting Approval

* Approved Application

* Rejected Application

* Supervisor Review Required



Use realistic operational notifications such as:



* New Application Submitted

* Beneficiary Record Updated

* Service Record Created

* Document Uploaded

* Service In Progress

* Service Completed



UI CLEANUP



* Remove all lorem ipsum text.

* Remove empty cards.

* Remove placeholder charts.

* Remove placeholder notifications.

* Remove fake activity feeds.

* Remove autogenerated random statistics.

* Remove duplicate records.

* Remove approval buttons.

* Remove approval badges.

* Remove approval status columns.

* Remove approval filters.

* Remove approval dashboards.

* Remove approval workflow references.

* Ensure all displayed data is interconnected and realistic.



FINAL GOAL



The entire PMS should function as a realistic MSWD demonstration system using only 5 interconnected beneficiary profiles. All dashboards, reports, analytics, service modules, notifications, activities, statistics, and beneficiary records must dynamically reflect those same records. The system should operate without a Supervisor role and without any approval workflow, providing a clean, realistic, professional, and believable thesis presentation environment.
